items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Arthur Durbney, Elliot Taylor, Manuel Sayles, and Simon Moreira.

ctx.x: No, I mean, in 32 or so.

Oh, he broke up with P. the book out there. Yeah. He just quit the band. See, he quit the band with P. the book out there. Then he made up this band. See, he consists of me, Eddie Pearson, Leo Desjard, Joe Phillips, Arthur Durbney, Elliot Taylor, Manuel Sayles, and Simon Moreira. And a singer by the name of Harold Wells. That was his band. And we played together from 32 until 35. I did.
And I left the band in 35.
